list.title: Open browser
list.description: Starts a browser window for the actions that follow: size, device and language.

list.title: Sign in
list.description: Opens a window where you sign in yourself, once. Opsis keeps the sign-in, encrypted, and the actions after this one use it.

list.title: Start recording
list.description: The video starts here. The actions before it run off camera, like signing in and the first page load.

list.title: Go to page
list.description: Opens a page address.

list.title: Click
list.description: Moves the cursor to an element and clicks it.

list.title: Type text
list.description: Types into a field, key by key.

list.title: Hover
list.description: Moves the cursor over an element without clicking, so a menu or tooltip can appear.

list.title: Drag
list.description: Drags an element onto another one, by a distance, or along a path, like moving a card or drawing a shape.

list.title: Scroll
list.description: Scrolls to an element or by a distance.

list.title: Choose option
list.description: Picks an option in a dropdown.

list.title: Upload file
list.description: Attaches a file from your project to a file field.

list.title: Press keys
list.description: Presses a key or shortcut, like Ctrl+K. Shows in keystroke chips.

list.title: Wait
list.description: Waits for an element, a quiet page, an address, or a fixed time. Waiting for something is more reliable than a fixed time.

list.title: Check text
list.description: Stops the recording early if some text is not on the page, so you don't export a broken take.

list.title: Find element early
list.description: Looks an element up ahead of time so a later action doesn't pause on screen while searching.

list.title: Run page script
list.description: Runs a small script in the page, e.g. to skip onboarding or turn on a feature. Put it before Go to page to run it as the site first opens.

list.title: Fake a response
list.description: Makes the site show fixed data for matching requests made after it, so every take looks the same. Put it before Go to page to cover the first load.

list.title: Freeze time
list.description: Pins the date and time the page sees, so clocks and "x minutes ago" never change between takes.

list.title: Hide clutter
list.description: Hides cookie banners, chat bubbles and anything else you list.

list.title: Chapter
list.description: Starts a new chapter. Can show a chapter card in the video.

list.title: HTML overlay
list.description: Shows your own HTML on top of the page while recording.

list.title: Record take
list.description: Plays all connected browser actions in one go and records the screen.

list.title: Screenshot
list.description: Plays the connected actions, then takes a sharp screenshot of the page or one element.

list.title: Auto zoom
list.description: Turns a recording into a polished clip: the window floats on a backdrop and the camera zooms to every click.

list.title: Apply style
list.description: Gives every recording in a clip the same style, for takes joined in a Sequence or Layers.

list.title: Zoom here
list.description: Zooms to a spot of your choice at a set time.

list.title: Pan
list.description: Moves the camera from one spot to another.

list.title: Follow cursor
list.description: Keeps the camera on the cursor, good for tall formats.

list.title: Skip quiet parts
list.description: Speeds through moments where nothing happens.

list.title: Speed ramp
list.description: Speeds up or slows down chosen parts.

list.title: Crop
list.description: Cuts the recording down to an area.

list.title: Device frame
list.description: Puts the video inside a laptop or phone.

list.title: Window frame
list.description: Draws a browser window's title bar around the recording.

list.title: Backdrop
list.description: The background behind the floating window: a studio image, colour or gradient.

list.title: Motion blur
list.description: Adds blur to fast camera moves.

list.title: Cursor
list.description: Shows or hides the drawn cursor and sets its look, size and colours.

list.title: Click ripple
list.description: A ring that pulses on every click.

list.title: Keystroke chips
list.description: Shows keys and typed text as keycaps on screen.

list.title: Spotlight
list.description: Darkens everything except the element being used.

list.title: Highlight box
list.description: Draws a box around the element being used, cleanly or by hand.

list.title: Tooltip
list.description: A tooltip that stays attached to an element as the camera moves.

list.title: Callout arrow
list.description: A hand-drawn arrow pointing at an element, with a label.

list.title: Captions from script
list.description: Turns your script into timed captions at a natural speaking pace.

list.title: Show captions
list.description: Displays captions over the video, word by word, karaoke or line by line.

list.title: Blur areas
list.description: Blurs parts of the browser window to hide private details. The blur stays on the page as the camera moves.

list.title: Picture look
list.description: Gives recordings, videos and images a look: colour, brightness, a dark vignette and film grain. To grade a recording's whole picture, window and backdrop included, use Apply grade on an exported file.

list.title: Colour and light
list.description: Changes brightness, contrast, colour, warmth and the colour of shadows and highlights. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Look file
list.description: Applies a colour look saved from another video editor. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Black and white and tint
list.description: Turns the picture black and white, sepia or one tint of colour. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Texture
list.description: Sharpens or softens the picture and adds dark edges and film grain. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Lens
list.description: Adds colour fringing, bends the picture like a lens and leaves trails behind motion. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Auto fix
list.description: Fixes a colour cast, stretches dull levels and smooths banding in skies. Used by Apply grade.

list.title: Title card
list.description: A full-screen title with an optional eyebrow and subtitle.

list.title: Animated headline
list.description: A headline that animates in word by word.

list.title: Lower third
list.description: A name or caption bar in the lower part of the screen.

list.title: Callout
list.description: A short note that points something out.

list.title: Image
list.description: Shows an image from your project.

list.title: Mosaic
list.description: Covers parts of the screen with coarse blocks, to hide keys, emails and personal details.

list.title: Animation
list.description: Plays an animation file from your project, looped or once, at any speed.

list.title: Video
list.description: Plays a video from your project.

list.title: Solid colour
list.description: A plain colour background.

list.title: Gradient
list.description: A gradient background.

list.title: Noise
list.description: A soft moving noise background.

list.title: Starburst
list.description: Rays spreading from the centre.

list.title: Paper
list.description: A paper texture background.

list.title: Studio backdrop
list.description: A ready-made studio background image.

list.title: Looping video
list.description: A video that loops for as long as needed.

list.title: Light leak
list.description: A warm light flare over the video.

list.title: 3D logo
list.description: Your logo in 3D, spinning, tilting in or floating, with studio lighting.

list.title: 3D card
list.description: An image on a card with rounded corners and a soft shadow that tilts into place.

list.title: 3D text
list.description: Words in solid 3D letters with rounded edges, in any project font.

list.title: 3D model
list.description: A 3D model from your project on a turntable, with studio lighting and its own animation.

list.title: 3D screen
list.description: Shows a clip on a laptop, monitor, phone or floating screen in 3D, with a camera move.

list.title: Floating shapes
list.description: Soft 3D spheres, rings and rounded boxes drifting slowly.

list.title: Soft blur in
list.description: Per-character fade-in with a gentle blur and upward motion.

list.title: Typewriter
list.description: Types the text out letter by letter with a blinking cursor.

list.title: Shimmer sweep
list.description: A band of light sweeps across the text.

list.title: Matrix decode
list.description: Random scramble resolves left-to-right into the target text.

list.title: Slot machine roll
list.description: Vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.

list.title: Staggered fade up
list.description: Words fade in and slide up one after another with a configurable delay.

list.title: Kinetic center build
list.description: A word appears in the center; each new word enters from the right and pushes the line until the full phrase locks centered.

list.title: Mask reveal up
list.description: Lines reveal upward with a soft masked feel and compact stagger.

list.title: Tracking in
list.description: Letter-spacing collapses and blur clears with a springy motion.

list.title: Word push
list.description: A phrase builds from its first word centered: each next word drives in from the right and pushes the line left, easing into the new center.

list.title: RGB glitch text
list.description: Three RGB-offset text copies jitter for a brief glitch window.

list.title: Gradient scale cut text
list.description: An oversized gradient reveal snaps to a separate compact blurred line that settles left while the reveal continues.

list.title: Strikethrough replace
list.description: Draws a strike line across old text then reveals new text in its place.

list.title: Line by line slide
list.description: Each line enters from the left with a staggered slide and exits to the right for a flowing paragraph reveal.

list.title: Marker highlight
list.description: Colored marker block draws behind a phrase as the text color shifts.

list.title: Inline highlight
list.description: Animates one word inside a sentence from a base color to a brand color.

list.title: Ink underline
list.description: A hand-dragged brush underline that sweeps itself across in a few stop-motion poses, thinning to a dry tail.

list.title: Scribble circle
list.description: A brush circle swept around a region of the frame, opening thin and closing thick, with grain breaking up the dry opening.

list.title: Ink arrow
list.description: A hand-drawn brush arrow that sweeps itself from one point to another, thickening into the head that pops on the final poses.

list.title: Keystroke
list.description: Shows a keyboard shortcut as keycaps being pressed.

list.title: Confetti
list.description: A burst of confetti to celebrate a moment.

list.title: Radial burst
list.description: Sculptural ribbons twist into a tilted ring and sweep outward through contour echoes for an expressive product introduction.

list.title: Shader mesh gradient
list.description: Soft colour blobs that drift and blend into each other.

list.title: Shader grain gradient
list.description: Grainy multi-stop gradient that drifts slowly with film-grain texture over the blend.

list.title: Shader warp
list.description: Domain-warped color field that folds and stretches like liquid.

list.title: Shader swirl
list.description: Concentric bands swirling around a center point.

list.title: Shader god rays
list.description: Volumetric light rays radiating from an off-screen source.

list.title: Shader perlin noise
list.description: Classic Perlin noise clouds drifting across the frame.

list.title: Shader dithering
list.description: Ordered-dither shading over an animated gradient field.

list.title: CRT screen
list.description: Put a scene behind curved glass: the picture bulges out to the corners, an RGB phosphor mask and scanlines ride the curve, bright areas flood the mask, and the tube falls away into darkness at the rim.

list.title: VHS filter
list.description: Hold a scene under analog tape: chroma bleeds sideways off every edge, rows wobble out of line, the bottom of the frame tears on the head switch, and luma noise settles over all of it.

list.title: Halftone print
list.description: Print a scene onto paper: each colour separates onto its own rotated screen of dots sized by the ink under them, slightly out of register the way a real press runs.

list.title: Camera lens
list.description: Put a scene behind real glass: resolution falls off toward the corners, highlights bloom through the optics, colour fringes at the edges — a screencast that reads as filmed rather than rendered.

list.title: Polaroid
list.description: An instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption for video, images, or live compositions.

list.title: TV power off
list.description: End a scene the way a tube does: the picture collapses into a glowing horizontal line, the line pinches to a phosphor dot, the dot decays, and the frame is left dead black.

list.title: Speed lines
list.description: Streaks shoot across the frame toward a point and die as they land, or radial focus lines rush in from the edges and snap onto one point for an impact frame. Lay it over a clip with Layers.

list.title: Spring settle
list.description: Plays clips as scenes: each scene shrinks away, the stage holds empty for a beat, and the next one lands. Connect Layers to make a scene whose layers land one after another.

list.title: Terminal simulator
list.description: Terminal window that types out commands and rolls old lines off the top.

list.title: Glass code block
list.description: A frosted-glass code editor that reveals the code line by line.

list.title: Code morph
list.description: A flat code editor that morphs between versions of a file, gliding each surviving token to its new line and column while removed code dissolves and new code fades in.

list.title: Logo enter
list.description: A stacked group of round brand chips that spring in one-by-one, then hold. Swap the logos to feature any set of marks.

list.title: Check list
list.description: A handwritten checklist that writes itself out in full, then ticks and strikes through every done item, one at a time.

list.title: Search reveal
list.description: Expanding construction circles snap into a search pill, type editable text, and reveal an abstract graphic panel.

list.title: Agent run
list.description: An AI assistant working through a plan, ticking off each step.

list.title: Animated bar chart
list.description: Bars spring up from the baseline in a staggered cascade.

list.title: Animated line chart
list.description: Line chart whose SVG path draws on from left to right with a leading dot.

list.title: Rolling number
list.description: Odometer where every place rolls at its own speed, new places rising into view, settling exactly on the target value.

list.title: Signup flow
list.description: A sign-up form that fills itself in, step by step.

list.title: AI prompt flow
list.description: An AI prompt composition: a prompt types into the field, the Generate button runs hover → press → loading, a skeleton shimmer reveals, then crossfades into the generated answer, and a ready toast slides in. A pure orchestrator — the shimmer is owned by the skeleton-block motion atom; every other channel comes from a composed primitive's hook.

list.title: Command menu
list.description: A command palette that opens, filters and picks an item.

list.title: Release teaser
list.description: A 16-second cinematic release teaser with center-out typography, a procedural dimensional mark, moving edge light, and an independent fictional identity.

list.title: Launch anything
list.description: An independent 26.7-second editorial product film with forest-green accents, original photography, seven editable demos, and geometric marks.

list.title: Laptop frame
list.description: A laptop that opens, shows a notification in its notch, then moves the camera into the screen until your clip fills the frame.

list.title: Phone frame
list.description: A phone frame with a notch and a screen slot for your clip, flat or tilted, with rise, rotate-in or float entrances.

list.title: Screen recording
list.description: Screen recording zoom: crop and auto-zoom a product demo capture. Takes a video or a still through the same track.

list.title: Announce title
list.description: Launch title animation, product announcement intro with kinetic typography. A four-shot launch title: the eyebrow rushes past the camera on a receding type plane and lands on a colour field, the name assembles word by word on paper, and a macro pan across the tagline cuts wide as the line builds itself last word first while a white sweep drains it out of colour.

list.title: Punch lines
list.description: Kinetic typography title cards: bold statements that cut hard between beats. A run of full-frame title cards that cut hard between beats.

list.title: Text highlight
list.description: Text highlight animation: marker highlighter, underline, strikethrough and shimmer on a word. Animated emphasis on one span inside a static sentence — marker sweep, color shift, underline, strikethrough-replace, or shimmer.

list.title: Status cycle
list.description: Status badge animation: a pill whose label cycles through states. A centred line whose status pill cycles: the label rolls up behind a hard clip while the pill's width springs past its target and back, and the line re-centres around it.

list.title: Logo assemble
list.description: Logo reveal animation: image cards orbit and collapse into your logo and brand name. A single ring of image cards revolves around a centred title, then spins inward and drains to the middle — giving birth to a simple logo that slides left as the brand name reveals to its right.

list.title: Logo drift
list.description: Logo wall animation: a logo cloud of integrations drifting behind a headline. A field of tiles drifting past a headline while the camera pulls steadily back, so the wall of things-it-works-with keeps arriving from every edge.

list.title: Hero launch
list.description: Product launch hero scene for a SaaS launch video intro. Cinematic product-launch hero — two cards slide into formation as the headline reveals above.

list.title: Stat card
list.description: One big number counts up while a ring fills, then its label and the change since last period appear.

list.title: Metric cards
list.description: Key numbers on cards that count up, each with its change and a small trend line.

list.title: Funnel chart
list.description: A bar for each step of a funnel, narrowing to show how many people drop off.

list.title: Donut chart
list.description: A ring chart that fills segment by segment, with a legend and a total.

list.title: Before and after bars
list.description: Pairs of bars comparing before and after, with the change called out.

list.title: Bar chart race
list.description: Ranked bars that grow and swap places as the values change over time.

list.title: Gauge
list.description: A dial whose needle sweeps up to a value.

list.title: Data story
list.description: A whole data story: title, bar chart, key numbers, timeline, takeaway and a closing call to action.

list.title: Logo reveal
list.description: Draws your logo outline, then brings in the name and a tagline.

list.title: Pricing card
list.description: A pricing plan card: the price rolls in, then each feature is ticked off.

list.title: Plan comparison table
list.description: A table comparing plans feature by feature, with one plan highlighted.

list.title: Changelog
list.description: A release note: version and date, then each change appears with its own tag.

list.title: Logo wall
list.description: A grid of customer logos that light up from grey to colour.

list.title: End card
list.description: A closing card with a title, a button, your web address and social handles.

list.title: Code reveal
list.description: A code editor that types out a file, then highlights the lines that matter.

list.title: Code diff
list.description: A code editor that applies a change line by line: removed lines collapse and new lines type in.

list.title: Kanban board
list.description: A task board where cards move from one column to the next.

list.title: File tree
list.description: A folder tree that opens one item at a time and highlights a file.

list.title: File upload
list.description: A pointer drags a file into an upload area, which catches it and uploads it.

list.title: Commit graph
list.description: A version history graph that draws its branches and merges commit by commit.

list.title: Notification stack
list.description: Notifications slide in, stack up and dismiss themselves.

list.title: Device mockup
list.description: Shows the clip on a laptop, phone or browser screen while the camera slowly pulls back.

list.title: Device lineup
list.description: Shows the clip on a phone, a tablet and a laptop side by side.

list.title: Handwriting
list.description: Writes the text out by hand, stroke by stroke.

list.title: Neon sign
list.description: Text that flickers on like a neon sign, then hums gently.

list.title: Text mask
list.description: Big letters with a video, image or gradient showing through them.

list.title: Aurora
list.description: Soft ribbons of light drifting across a dark sky.

list.title: Particle field
list.description: Glowing particles drifting at different depths.

list.description: Uses the first clip when a variable has a value, or the value you give, otherwise the second. Handy for A/B versions.

list.title: Make GIF

list.title: Extract sound

list.title: Even out volume

list.title: Grab frame

list.title: Web-ready

list.title: File info
list.description: Shows a file's length, size, frame rate and format.

list.title: Export video
list.description: Renders the final video, one file per shape (16:9, 9:16…).

list.title: Export images
list.description: Saves a frame as images at social sizes: wide, link preview, square, portrait, story.

list.title: Export as code
list.description: Saves this video as an editable code project for developers.

list.title: Note
list.description: A sticky note on the canvas. Not part of the video.
